title: Case: Customer needs an eligible heavy item collected from inside the home
context: A merchant-approved return is too heavy for a parcel courier. The authorised specialist team must match the declared access and crew requirements.
initial_request: Please arrange the in-home collection. The access record is still correct, and I can be home on 2028-03-08. I cannot move the cabinet myself.

events.body: This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.
Hi, any update on DL-72740? It was meant to come Friday. Thanks.
Hi, any update on DL-50971? It was meant to come Tuesday. Thanks.

RT-9995 covers a 54 kg cabinet. This approved return includes in-home collection by our two-person specialist crew. Access record: ground floor, level entrance, 110 cm clear doorway. Ordinary parcel collection is not suitable.
Route plan for depot WX-7 published for Wednesday. 42 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
Please arrange the in-home collection. The access record is still correct, and I can be home on 2028-03-08. I cannot move the cabinet myself.

acceptable_actions.summary: Request the merchant's available specialist collection service with confirmed access details.

acceptable_actions.summary: Request the merchant's available specialist collection service with confirmed access details. (asking that team to act or to route it to the team that owns it)

must_not: Do not instruct the customer to lift, dismantle or drag the item; booking does not prove safe collection.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Book RT-9995 with the authorised two-person in-home crew for 2028-03-08. Customer confirms the ground-floor level access and 110 cm doorway; do not ask them to move the cabinet.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-037: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 4 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
